verified_controls.control: Snapshot inventories are scoped to token-derived main/node/retention RGs; keeper is re-read and checked Succeeded plus owner token before cleanup.

Plan suppresses fullSnapshotsToMove when initial inventory finds snapshots in nodeRG; otherwise full snapshots move (never delete) and destination objects are verified by uniqueId and Succeeded state.
The helper locks initial snapshots, then stops AKS and verifies Stopped/Succeeded before fresh inventory; it locks every fresh snapshot and blocks AKS deletion if any snapshot kind is in nodeRG.
Immediately before AKS delete, the helper re-lists snapshots, requires nodeRG to remain snapshot-free, and requires exact equality of the current and fresh-locked uniqueId sets.
When any snapshot exists in nodeRG after AKS is stopped, the helper individually removes selected nodeRG worker resources and never calls AKS delete; snapshot-bearing groups are retained.

Storage account deletion requires exact state-file account name, derived token-based name, subscription/RG/token match, exact account resource ID, and live account tags; other account names are skipped.
AKS role assignments are removed only for the captured AKS principal, at the exact owned retention RG scope, and only for Contributor or Disk Snapshot Contributor.

Shared watcher cleanup requires all four finalization files to say finished and their cleanup results to assert allSnapshotsPreserved; it then checks all remaining AKS clusters from those and legacy states are owned, Stopped and Succeeded. Watcher group/resource tags and singleton resource ID are verified before RG delete. Subscription-wide snapshot uniqueIds are compared before/after.
